root_cause.text: `skb_consume_udp()` invokes `skb_attempt_defer_free()` without first calling `skb_orphan()` to clear `skb->destructor`, which may have been set by the skmsg layer.
root_cause.evidence: The patch adds `skb_orphan(skb)` immediately before `skb_attempt_defer_free(skb)` in `skb_consume_udp()`, preventing a `DEBUG_NET_WARN_ON_ONCE(skb->destructor)` warning triggered when the skmsg layer sets the destructor via `skb_set_owner_sk_safe()` in `udp_read_skb()`.

intent_record.intent_summary: Orphan the socket buffer before attempting deferred freeing in UDP consumption to safely release socket references.
intent_record.what: Added a call to skb_orphan(skb) immediately before skb_attempt_defer_free(skb) inside the skb_consume_udp function.
intent_record.how: This ensures the socket buffer is disassociated from its owning socket before being queued for deferred freeing, preventing socket reference leaks and potential use-after-free issues.
